title: Bouch Web Workbench V0.1
summary: Frozen, qualified reference workbench for agent-driven web development with browser verification. Consult before building or checking a web page, or before inventing a way for an agent to see its rendered output: a calibrated capture instrument (Playwright and axe in Chromium at 375 and 1280 wide) that gates on console and request errors, serious accessibility violations, horizontal overflow and silent font fallback; a contract that requires reading the screenshots and keeps runtime evidence, deterministic checks, agent critique and human judgement separate; calibration against planted defects; and a pinned-container reproduction procedure. Requires Node 24 and a Chromium, or git and Docker to reproduce.

source.note: The qualified V0.1 release. The repository's main branch continues development and is not this record.
